writeup: TIC 229845475 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 3.1858 days. Automated TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a 9.11% dimming of the star's light, with a detection significance of 159.4 on the BLS scale. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at the target location, though with a centroid offset of 3.1 arcsec. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel object. The pipeline's machine learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.33, indicating moderate confidence that this represents a real eclipsing binary rather than a false positive. All automated data quality checks passed without flags.
